CVE-2026-92392.why: HTTP/2 upload use-after-free (curl 8.22.0, fixed in 8.23.0). Nextcloud 35 sends its outgoing requests over HTTP/2 (Http/Client/Client.php: CURL_HTTP_VERSION_2TLS) through php-curl, which links this curl, and federation (federatedfilesharing, cloud_federation_api) is enabled: any user sharing to a remote cloud ID makes Nextcloud POST to that server, so an attacker's server can answer the upload. Risk here: medium (high attack complexity, runs as the nextcloud PHP worker). Fix: curl 8.23.0 with the estate pin (staging-next-26.05).

CVE-2026-108693.why: NTGhostscriptEXE() launching gswin64c.exe by bare name is Windows-only code; the nextcloud VM runs Linux, where ImageMagick calls the gs binary from its own store path.

CVE-2014-9826.why:
SUN coder error handling fixed in ImageMagick 6.8.9 (2014); 7.1.2-32 contains the fix, the match comes from a version-less CVE record.
carried from 7.1.2-31 on 2026-11-09

CVE-2017-5506.why:
Double free in profile.c fixed in 6.9.7-4 / 7.0.4-4; 7.1.2-32 contains the fix.
carried from 7.1.2-31 on 2026-11-09

CVE-2026-20884.why: deflate_dng_load_raw integer overflow (TALOS-2026-2364) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit aa4458e, Debian marks 0.22.1-1 fixed); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.

CVE-2026-24450.why: uncompressed_fp_dng_load_raw overflow (TALOS-2026-2363) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit c911c9b); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.

CVE-2026-20911.why: HuffTable::initval overflow (TALOS-2026-2330) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit 5357bb5); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.

CVE-2026-21413.why: lossless_jpeg_load_raw overflow (TALOS-2026-2331) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit 75ed2c1); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.

CVE-2025-7425.why: libxslt is only linked into nginx's built-in xslt filter, and the nextcloud nginx.conf has no xslt_stylesheet directive, so no XSLT is ever run; the libxml2 it links (2.15.4) also carries the upstream mitigation (>= 2.14.5).

CVE-2022-0543.why: Debian/Ubuntu packaging bug (Lua loaded as a dynamic library, exposing package/loadlib); nixpkgs builds redis with its bundled Lua and this Nextcloud instance listens only on a unix socket.

CVE-2022-3734.why: Concerns an unofficial Windows port (dbghelp.dll search path); upstream Redis on Linux is not affected.
